name: ASAP 2.0 (essay and assignment only)

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.scope: Dataset text and numeric ratings; excludes third-party article/reading-material full texts.

holistic_essay_score.instruction: Predict the human holistic quality score for this persuasive essay on the ordered scale from 1 (lowest quality) to 6 (highest quality). Use the assignment topic and instructions when supplied. Source reading materials are not supplied.
holistic_essay_score.field_description: prompt_name: Original assignment topic/title, not an essay or student identifier.; assignment: Original short assignment instructions if available; null means the source literal NA/empty, never inferred.; essay: Original student essay. Third-party source reading materials are excluded.

field_descriptions.prompt_name: Original assignment topic/title, not an essay or student identifier.
field_descriptions.assignment: Original short assignment instructions if available; null means the source literal NA/empty, never inferred.
field_descriptions.essay: Original student essay. Third-party source reading materials are excluded.

text_policy: Original selected text and capitalization preserved byte-for-byte after UTF-8/CSV decoding; grouping uses a separate whitespace-normalized casefolded hash. No spelling correction, truncation, label imputation, or score transformation.
grouping_rule: Whitespace-normalized casefolded essay text hashes. Source essay IDs are unique but are not student IDs; student-disjointness cannot be established. For prompt transfer, hold out whole prompt_name topics in a separate evaluation.
split_policy: Official train/test assignments preserved exactly. No official validation partition is provided; derive any validation split within train only, retaining connected groups. Exact/normalized duplicates across official splits are flagged, not silently reassigned.
source_citation: Crossley et al., ASAP 2.0 corpus; repository https://github.com/scrosseye/ASAP_2.0 ; paper https://zenodo.org/records/14781349
known_cross_dataset_overlap: Publisher states that a substantial subset comes from PERSUADE 2.0. Do not treat PERSUADE and ASAP2 as independent sources in future joint splits; compare original essay identity/text first.
quality_findings: The pinned archives contain 24,728 rows (17,307 train and 7,421 test); README states 24,278 and component counts sum to 24,700. File counts take precedence in this release.
Labels are six ordered integer scores, not genuinely continuous measurements.
All seven prompts have short assignment instructions in some rows; 28 individual rows across five prompts have literal NA, preserved as null without filling from another essay.

No third-party reading-material ZIP was downloaded or published. This is an essay/assignment-only score prediction variant; source-evidence faithfulness cannot be fully evaluated without reading materials.
No student IDs are exposed by the source schema; essay IDs cannot prove student-disjointness.

checks: All retained labels finite and within documented rating scale
Every retained input and label compared with its original decoded CSV/TSV row
Every source row accounted for; invalid/missing labels never imputed
Explicit input allowlists exclude source IDs, other scores, bins, demographics and article full texts
Official splits retained; cross-split identical inputs and connected groups counted and flagged
Source version, downloaded bytes and SHA256 recorded

deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
